_comment: Written by injury-returns.mjs: every rostered injured player's derived return, with its source and the day it was looked up; irSince (IR / PUP: the week he went on the list) is carried forward run to run. A record, not an input — hand entries go in injury-returns.json.

2133.retNote: https://www.nfl.com/news/rams-targeting-week-13-return-for-davante-adams-puka-nacua-out-extended-period-of-time — Ruptured hamstring (surgery). McVay: targeting a return after the Week 12 Packers game, i.e. Week 13 vs KC on TNF Dec 3. Out Week 12 (LAR bye Week 11).

2216.retNote: consensus.mjs — Consensus: matches audit; uncertain (audit tiebreak wk 11).

Minter (Nov 13): typically 6-10 weeks. NBC (Nov 13) and USA Today (Nov 16): Week 15 or 16 at the earliest; ESPN return date Dec 27. Back Week 16 (Dec 27): out Weeks 11-15 (BAL bye Week 13).
